model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представя стойностите на Per-Output и Per-Layer, в зависимост от Sparsity Rate. На хоризонталната ос е показана Sparsity Rate, която варира от 20% до 80% с интервали по 10%. Скалата на тази ос е линейна. Вертикалната ос показва Perplexity, като използва логаритмична скала, варираща от 10 до 10^3. Посочените стойности на Perplexity са обозначени в тази скала. Двата набора от данни са представени чрез стълбове, първият е в син цвят (Per-Layer) и вторият в оранжев цвят (Per-Output). Най-късият син стълб достига стойност около 10^2, докато най-късият оранжев стълб достига стойност малко по-голяма от 10^2. Най-високият син стълб достига стойност около 10^3, а най-високият оранжев стълб достига стойност над 10^3, почти достигайки 1.2*10^3. Вариациите във височината на стълбовете за всеки набор от данни показват промени в стойностите на Perplexity с увеличаване на Sparsity Rate. Стълбовете са подредени по нарастващ ред на Sparsity Rate.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图表展示了困惑值与稀疏率之间的关系，对比了“每输出”和“每层”两种不同的测量方法。横轴表示稀疏率，标签为“Sparsity Rate”，刻度从 20% 至 80%，以 10% 为增量。纵轴表示困惑值，标签为“Perplexity”，采用对数刻度，范围从 10⁰ (1) 到 10³ (1000)。图表由一组并排的柱状图组成，每组柱状图代表一个特定的稀疏率。图表中包含两种颜色：蓝色和橙色，分别代表“Per-Output”和“Per-Layer” 的困惑值。例如，在 20% 的稀疏率下，“Per-Output” 的困惑值约为 10，而 “Per-Layer” 的困惑值约为 20。随着稀疏率的增加，两个系列的困惑值都呈现增长的趋势。在 80% 的稀疏率下， “Per-Output” 的困惑值约为 800， “Per-Layer" 的困惑值约为 900。柱状图按照稀疏率从小到大的顺序排列。图中没有对任何特定的柱状图施加强调。
model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the relationship between sparsity rate and perplexity for two different configurations, labeled "Per-Output" and "Per-Layer." The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, ranging from 20% to 80% in increments of 10%, and is labeled "Sparsity Rate." The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled "Perplexity," and uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 10<sup>-2</sup> to 10<sup>3</sup>, with tick labels at 10<sup>-2</sup>, 10<sup>-1</sup>, 1, 10<sup>2</sup>, and 10<sup>3</sup>. Two sets of bars are displayed; the "Per-Output" configuration is represented by blue bars, and the "Per-Layer" configuration by orange bars. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each sparsity rate value. The shortest blue bar, corresponding to a sparsity rate of 20%, has a length representing an approximate perplexity value of 0.1, while the tallest blue bar, corresponding to a sparsity rate of 80%, has a length representing an approximate perplexity value of 60. The shortest orange bar, corresponding to 20% sparsity rate, has a length representing an approximate perplexity value of 0.05, while the tallest orange bar, representing an 80% sparsity rate, exhibits a length corresponding to an approximate perplexity value of 80. Generally, the length of both bar sets decreases as the sparsity rate increases. No specific bar is visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
model_annotations.German: Das vorliegende Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Perplexity pro Ausgabe und die Perplexity pro Schicht in Bezug auf die Sparsity-Rate. Die horizontale Achse stellt die Sparsity-Rate dar, beginnend bei 20% und bis zu 80%, mit Tick-Markierungen in 10%-Schritten. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Perplexity dar, mit einer logarithmischen Skala von 10% bis 10^3. Zwei Balkengruppen werden entlang der Sparsity-Rate dargestellt, wobei die erste Gruppe in einem Blau- und die zweite Gruppe in einem Orangeton dargestellt wird. Der bläuliche Balken, der der Sparsity-Rate von 20% entspricht, hat einen Wert von ungefähr 10^2, während der bläuliche Balken, der der Sparsity-Rate von 80% entspricht, einen Wert von ungefähr 5 * 10^2 hat. Der orangefarbene Balken, der der Sparsity-Rate von 20% entspricht, hat einen Wert von ungefähr 1 * 10^2, während der orangefarbene Balken, der der Sparsity-Rate von 80% entspricht, einen Wert von ungefähr 7 * 10^2 hat. Die Balken sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge sortiert, aber einige Balken, insbesondere die bei höheren Sparsity-Raten, sind etwas größer in der Breite, was sie visuell hervorhebt.
